metas.name: 2026 · Whalefall
metas.description: Follows a scuba diver who, while looking for his father's remains, is swallowed by an 80-foot, 60-ton sperm whale and has just one hour to get out before his oxygen runs out.

metas.name: ★ 4.3 · 2026 · V/H/S/Mixtape
metas.description: It presents a new anthology in which music and sound become a source of terror.

metas.name: 2026 · Other Mommy
metas.description: Bela, an 8-year-old girl living in a home with marital problems, confronts a sinister entity which comes out of her closet. The presence, whom she calls "Other Mommy," becomes increasingly threatening to her and her family.

metas.name: 2026 · Resident Evil
metas.description: Follows a hapless courier tasked with delivering a package to a remote hospital. He soon finds himself caught in the middle of an outbreak and must fight through hordes of mutated creatures to survive.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Onslaught
metas.description: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · Buddy
metas.description: A brave girl and her friends must escape a kids television show.

metas.name: ★ 5.8 · 2025 · It Ends
metas.description: Friends on a late-night food run become trapped on an infinite highway with otherworldly terrors lurking beyond. Confined in their car, they must decide whether to accept their fate or attempt escape.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Insidious: Out of the Further
metas.description: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
metas.description: A director making a slasher sequel becomes obsessed with casting the original film's 'final girl,' leading both women into psychological and sexual chaos.

metas.name: ★ 5.5 · 2026 · The Last House
metas.description: A family of four is suddenly sealed inside their house with no way out and must work together to survive against both their dwindling resources and the mysterious, looming threat that is keeping them trapped.

metas.name: ★ 3.8 · 2026 · Ice Cream Man
metas.description: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

metas.name: 2026 · Soulm8te
metas.description: A man acquires an Artificially Intelligent android to cope with the loss of his recently deceased wife. In an attempt to create a truly sentient partner, he inadvertently turns a harmless lovebot into a deadly soulmate.

metas.name: 2026 · The Devil's Mouth
metas.description: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.

metas.name: ★ 5.1 · 2026 · Bhootam Bhayyam
metas.description: Seven unemployed friends move into a cursed mansion and discover a mysterious coin. Using it in planchette sessions for quick cash, they awaken ancient forces. Now spirits and occultists hunt them as dark secrets emerge.

metas.name: ★ 4.5 · 2026 · Her Private Hell
metas.description: When a mysterious mist engulfs a futuristic metropolis, unleashing a deadly and elusive entity, a troubled young woman searches for her father. Her quest collides with an American GI on a harrowing odyssey to rescue his daughter from Hell.

metas.name: ★ 5.4 · 2026 · Pinocchio: Unstrung
metas.description: A dark coming-of-age reimagining of Pinocchio, this unsettling tale follows the iconic puppet's disturbing journey toward becoming real.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2026 · Hope
metas.description: A mysterious discovery is made on the outskirts of the remote harbor town. The residents find themselves in a desperate fight for survival against something they have never encountered before.
